name: Umineko: When They Cry - Saku
summary:
Umineko: When They Cry - Saku is a collection of three official fan discs from the original Umineko series, released for the first time in the West by MangaGamer. This edition includes:
- Umineko: When They Cry - Tsubasa
A set of 15 short episodes originally distributed as a small booklet at Comiket, now adapted into visual novel format.
- Umineko: When They Cry - Hane
Features the stories Jessica and the Killer Electric Fan and Forgery No. XXX.
- Umineko: When They Cry - Saku
Includes the stories Our Confessions and Last Note of the Golden Witch, in which a new witch named Piece declares war on Battler, Enju, and Beatrice.

As with other MangaGamer releases, this version of Saku features newly drawn character sprites to match the upgraded Steam visuals, with the option to switch between them and Ryukishi07’s original artwork.
